title: Sui Staking & Governance
description: Learn about Sui's staking system and governance mechanisms, including validator selection, delegation, rewards, and how to participate in the network's decision-making processes.

tasks.title: Prepare for Staking
tasks.description: Add at least 0.1 SUI to your wallet to prepare for staking interactions

tasks.title: Staking Basics
tasks.description: Learn the fundamentals of staking on the Sui blockchain
tasks.question: What is the primary purpose of staking SUI tokens?
options: To earn interest like a savings account
To secure the network by selecting and incentivizing validators
To reduce the circulating supply of SUI
To qualify for NFT airdrops
tasks.correctAnswer: To secure the network by selecting and incentivizing validators

tasks.title: Validator Selection
tasks.description: Understanding how validators are selected on Sui
tasks.question: How are validators selected in the Sui network?
options: Random selection from all node operators
Based on amount of SUI staked with them
Through a committee vote by the Sui Foundation
First-come, first-served basis
tasks.correctAnswer: Based on amount of SUI staked with them

tasks.title: Staking Rewards
tasks.description: Learn about staking rewards on Sui
tasks.question: How are staking rewards distributed on Sui?
options: Fixed amounts daily
Proportionally based on stake amount and validator performance
Only to validators, not delegators
Through a lottery system
tasks.correctAnswer: Proportionally based on stake amount and validator performance

tasks.title: Delegation Process
tasks.description: Understanding how to delegate SUI tokens
tasks.question: What happens when you delegate SUI to a validator?
options: You transfer ownership of your SUI to the validator
You receive delegation tokens representing your staked SUI
Your SUI is locked for a fixed period of 21 days
You become a validator yourself
tasks.correctAnswer: You receive delegation tokens representing your staked SUI

tasks.title: Governance Participation
tasks.description: Learn how to participate in Sui governance
tasks.question: How can SUI holders participate in governance?
options: Only through running a validator node
By voting on proposals with their staked SUI
By joining the Sui Foundation
Governance is centralized and not open to token holders
tasks.correctAnswer: By voting on proposals with their staked SUI

tasks.title: Unstaking Process
tasks.description: Understanding how to unstake your SUI
tasks.question: What happens when you request to unstake your SUI?
options: Your SUI is returned immediately
Your SUI enters a warming period before becoming available
You must pay a fee to unstake
You can only unstake at designated times each month
tasks.correctAnswer: Your SUI enters a warming period before becoming available

tasks.title: Validator Performance
tasks.question: Which factor does NOT affect a validator's rewards on Sui?
options: Total amount of SUI delegated to them
Uptime and reliability
Gas fees from transactions they process
Their social media popularity

tasks.title: Sui Tokenomics
tasks.question: What percentage of the initial Sui token supply was allocated to the community reserve?
